title: Vibrant Garlicky Portuguese Chicken Skewers
description: A halal-friendly Portuguese dish featuring garlicky and crumbly chicken skewers, perfect for a post-workout meal, made with red pepper paste and air-fried to perfection, served on a wooden board.
instructions: Preheat the air fryer to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together red pepper paste, garlic, olive oil, salt, black pepper, and paprika.
Add the chicken pieces to the bowl and toss to coat evenly with the marinade.
Thread the marinated chicken pieces onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Air fry the chicken skewers for 12 minutes, shaking halfway through.
Brush the chicken skewers with lemon juice during the last 2 minutes of cooking.
Remove the chicken skewers from the air fryer and let them rest for 2 minutes.
Serve the chicken skewers on a wooden board, garnished with lemon wedges and fresh parsley.
